resources.string: Pauses videos and shows break reminders set by a parent. Does not read screen text or intercept remote buttons.
A parent has paused viewing.\nAsk them to allow viewing in the phone app.\nThis screen will close when viewing is allowed.
TV time is up for today
Take a break for now.\nA parent can add more viewing time in the phone app.\nThis screen will close when viewing is allowed.
It’s the break time your family agreed on.\nCome back later.\nA parent can change the schedule in the phone app.
Returning to the previous screen…\nIf it stays here, press Back on the remote.\nPress Play when you return to your video.
Please wait a moment.\nIf this screen stays here, ask a parent to check the TV connection in the phone app.
